Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Gay Week in Review, with Andy Humm, Darrell Yates Rist, Kitty Cotter, and Jim Levin, sponsored by the Human Rights Campaign Fund 2. Discussion of the 1987 National Lesbian and Gay Health Conference, and AIDS in politics overtaking gay rights issues COMMERCIAL: Human Rights Campaign Fund 3. Discussion of the AIDS and HIV tests, and personal issues surrounding testing 4. Andy Humm on "straightening up" a home to hide a homosexual lifestyle 5. News Watch, Georgia State Representative shelves legislation to criminalize homosexual sodomy due to controversy created 6. "Names Project," a quilt of the names of those killed by AIDS to be displayed on Washington Mall during the March on Washington 7. Philadelphia school-board condemns harassment of students based on sexual orientation, provides "sensitivity training" for teachers and administrators 8. Independent Catholic newspaper estimates that 50% of Catholic priests in the US are homosexual 9. Sports Report COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 10. Lavender Health, interview with Mary Anne Chaisson, member of the Department of Health's AIDS research unit, which collects data and tracks the epidemic in NYC 11. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Naming Names, Lifestyles and Trojan Condoms criticized for calling AIDS "a condom-makers dream" and refusing to advertise in gay publications COMMERCIAL: 10th Annual Awards Evening for the Fund for Human Dignity 2. Media Watch, with Brandon Judell, interview with John Dietrich of the Islanders Club, an adventure-oriented club COMMERCIAL: GCN Fundraiser 3. Episode of GCN's soap opera, "Suds": "See Spot Run" 4. Closing credits 5. COMMERCIAL: GCN Fundraiser
